title: NASA-UAP-VM001, Apollo 12, 1969
what_is_it: An archival NASA photograph of the lunar surface from the Apollo 12 mission, modified to highlight an area of interest.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the file; this extraction relies entirely on war.gov metadata and the CSV description.
The image has been visually modified/highlighted by the releasing agency, which can bias a viewer toward seeing a feature as anomalous.
NASA explicitly disclaims any factual or analytical conclusion about the highlighted 'unidentified phenomena' — the label does not confirm an anomaly.
Photographic artefacts (lens flare, film defects, reflections, dust) are common explanations for such features and cannot be ruled out from metadata alone.
Single-source item with no accompanying analysis, chain of custody, or original unmodified image provided.
